name: Focused Mounted Archery (Combat)
body:
You have dedicated your combat-training to the skill of using a missile weapon while riding at top speed.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 18, Ride 8 ranks, Mounted Archery, Mounted Combat, base attack bonus +6.

Benefit: Completely negate the penalty you take when using a ranged weapon while mounted. In addition, you add the mount’s Dexterity bonus, if any, to your AC while firing from its back.

Archers may use Rapid Shot and Mythic Rapid Shot to gain multiple attacks per round.

Lost Lore: Horses of the Wild – Copyright 2014 Frog God Games; Author Rob Manning
